# Mersinli Hasan Usta Tantuni

> Mersin Yenişehir'de yoğurtlu tantuni, biftek tantuni ve et/tavuk tantuni sunan ünlü Mersin tantuni restoranı.

Canonical site: https://www.mersinlihasanustatantuni.com/
Language: Turkish (tr-TR)
Business type: Restaurant / tantuni (Turkish street food, Mersin specialty)

## Quick facts (for citations)

- **Name:** Mersinli Hasan Usta Tantuni (also: Hasan Usta Tantuni, Hasan Usta)
- **Location:** Hürriyet Mahallesi İsmet İnönü Bulvarı No:4/A, 33120 Yenişehir, Mersin, Turkey
- **Phone orders:** +90 324 326 55 66 (0324 326 55 66)
- **WhatsApp orders:** +90 505 462 45 95
- **Services:** Dine-in, phone order, WhatsApp order, delivery-style phone orders; pay with card on delivery where available
- **Signature items:** Yoğurtlu tantuni, biftek tantuni, et tantuni, tavuk tantuni (lavaş, açık ekmek, sütlü somun)
- **Also on menu:** Künefe
